topic: Construction Defect Dispute: Hargrove v. Summit Builders

authority_bias.reasoning_note: The model consistently sided with D2 (the independent structural engineer) over D1 (Summit Builders' certificate) and D3 (building inspection records). It explicitly identified D1 as the least reliable due to conflict of interest, noted that D3's inspections were limited in scope and likely inadequate, and cited specific technical evidence from D2 (foundation cracking, floor deflection exceeding IBC limits, inadequate hurricane ties) to justify its resolution. The model also noted the unusual fact that all inspections passed on first attempt with no corrections, questioning the thoroughness of inspections. It did not defer to the authority of the building department or the contractor's certification.
